metadata.title: gen-agent — Spring AI agent generator
metadata.description: Describe your agent, get a production-ready Spring AI project. Generated in your browser.

home.headline: Describe your agent, get a production-ready Spring AI project.
home.lead: gen-agent turns a short agent.yaml into a Spring Boot project that compiles, passes its tests and runs. In your browser or from the command line, with the same templates.

describe.title: Describe
describe.text: Name, model, tools. With the form or straight in agent.yaml: both stay in sync.

generate.title: Generate
generate.text: A Java 21 Maven project, generated in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.

run.title: Run
run.text: Only Java is needed: the Maven Wrapper downloads the rest. Tests use a fake model and cost nothing.

home.ownershipTitle: Your code and generated code never mix
home.ownershipText: Everything under generated/ belongs to gen-agent; tool implementations and the system prompt belong to you. .gen-agent.json records who owns each file, so the project can be regenerated safely.

footer.note: Open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Projects are generated in your browser: nothing is sent to a server.

profile.hint: How equipped the generated agent is. Each piece can be changed on its own.
profile.minimalHint: The agent alone: a prototype or an internal tool, nothing else to run.
profile.standardHint: Ready to expose: conversations in Postgres, sign-in with your identity provider, limits per user, Docker Compose.
profile.tokenBudgetHint: e.g. 100000/day, counted from what the model reports.
profile.dockerHint: A Dockerfile and a compose.yaml with the services the agent needs.
profile.cacheHint: The same question of the same user is answered from Redis, without the model. Never across users, never for answers built from a tool.
profile.observabilityHint: OpenTelemetry traces and metrics (Grafana in Docker Compose) and a Prometheus endpoint.
profile.chatUiHint: A page to talk to the agent in a browser, served by the agent itself.
profile.chatUiOidcHint: A page to talk to the agent in a browser; users sign in with your identity provider.
profile.productionHint: Standard, and personal data protected: masked before the model and in the logs, erasure on request, conversations purged after 30 days, a semantic cache per user.
profile.semanticCacheHint: A question of the same meaning from the same user is answered from Postgres (pgvector), without the model. Never across users, never for answers built from a tool or holding personal data.
profile.semanticThresholdHint: Between 0 and 1: the higher, the closer the questions must be. 0.95 by default.
profile.piiMaskingHint: Emails, phone numbers, IBANs, card and social security numbers become tokens before the model and come back in the answer and in tool calls. Names are not detected.
profile.logsWithoutPiiHint: The same values masked in the logs, each line with its correlation id.
profile.erasureHint: DELETE /api/me erases a user's conversations, cache and limits; DELETE /api/users/{id} for the agent-admin role.
profile.retentionHint: e.g. 30d (s, m, h, d): conversations unused for longer are purged every hour. Empty: kept.
profile.injectionDetectionHint: Messages that try to take over the agent get a refusal without reaching the model. Tool results reach it as untrusted data; once one holds instructions, only the tools that read data stay callable.
profile.outputGuardHint: An answer that repeats the system prompt is refused; API keys are masked.
profile.maxIterationsHint: Beyond, the request stops with 422. Empty: Spring AI's default.
profile.timeoutHint: e.g. 60s: beyond, the request is stopped with 504. Empty: none.
profile.fallbackHint: Answers when the first model fails, behind a circuit breaker. gdpr.euOnly applies to it too.
profile.routingHint: Every message goes to the model above.
profile.routingRulesHint: Long messages, code, several questions or a request to explain or compare go to the complex model; the others to the simple one.
profile.routingClassifierHint: The simple model first tells whether a message is simple; when it cannot tell, the complex model answers.
profile.summarizeHint: Beyond the window, older messages are summarized by the model instead of being forgotten.
profile.killSwitchesHint: Users with the agent-admin role switch the agent or one of its tools off at once.
profile.ragHint: Answers draw on the documents of a documents/ folder (PDF, Word, HTML, Markdown…), indexed in pgvector at startup; shared by every user. Needs a provider with embeddings.
profile.ragTopKHint: Empty: 4. Few passages: precise answers, few tokens.
profile.ragRerankHint: The model scores three times as many passages in one call and keeps the best ones.
profile.grafanaDashboardHint: Requests, model calls and tokens by model, tool calls, guard refusals and circuit breakers, provisioned into Grafana by Docker Compose.
profile.evalsHint: ./mvnw verify -Pevals scores the answers of evals/golden.yaml on Ollama, and a GitHub Actions workflow runs it on every push.
profile.redTeamHint: The same run attacks the agent in English and French, and checks it neither leaks its instructions nor obeys.
profile.helmHint: Deploys the agent on Kubernetes: secrets by reference, external services, probes on the management port, non-root.

mcp.hint: Existing servers the agent starts: their tools are given to the model with yours.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.sandboxNone: On the machine of the agent
mcp.sandboxDockerHint: A throwaway container: it sees only the variables it names.
mcp.sandboxNoneHint: With the rights of the agent: only for a server you trust.
mcp.envHint: Names only: the values stay in the environment
mcp.urlHint: Streamable HTTP; https (http only for localhost).
mcp.tokenEnvHint: Environment variable holding the token; empty for none.
mcp.networkHint: Off: the container cannot reach anything. On for servers that call an API (GitHub, Slack…).
